topic: remove a water stain from suede shoes
core_question: How do I get a watermark out of suede shoes?
answer_summary: Rub the water-stained area with a suede eraser (or fine sandpaper), hold the spot over steam to relax the fibers, and brush it back up with a suede brush to blend the mark into the rest of the nap.
